canonical_project: MCI large south Iran data center in Shiraz
owner: Mobile Telecommunication Company of Iran (Hamrah-e Aval / MCI)
notes: Zoomit reported MCI began construction of a large south-Iran data center in Shiraz with 300-rack capacity, five times larger than the existing Shiraz data center, 1,000 billion toman investment, and an 18-month completion target. Current completion status was not confirmed in this pass.
